verdict.rationale: A government tax and customs service portal could plausibly offer event webhooks, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows sign-up for electronic notifications and summons, management of channels for receiving communications, and a site-level "follow this site" feature. None of these are registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a program can receive, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
